headline: Savannah police officer gave Flock login to ICE agent husband
summary: Former Savannah officer Amber Harpe was fired for sharing her Flock login. She gave access to her husband, an ICE agent, violating department protocols. SPD does not share Flock data with ICE, making the sharing unauthorized.

headline: Mister Organ: An Unsettling Documentary Review
summary: "Mister Organ" is a deeply unsettling documentary by David Farrier. It chronicles Michael Organ's intimate campaign of terror against those in his life. The film explores a unique kind of discomfort, distinct from other true-crime genres.

headline: Woman arrested in Philly for blocking delivery robot
summary: Carolyn Marvin was arrested for disorderly conduct in Philadelphia. She intentionally blocked an Uber delivery robot's path. Marvin stated she was protesting robots taking human delivery jobs.

headline: Video game ownership bill introduced in Congress
summary: Rep. Ritchie Torres introduced the "Power To The Players Act." The bill aims to guarantee consumers ownership of purchased games. It would direct the FTC to regulate against licensing agreements.

headline: The Simpsons' Apu Speaks for First Time in Nearly a Decade
summary: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon has finally spoken on The Simpsons. This marks his first speaking appearance in almost ten years. The character's return to dialogue is a significant moment for fans.

headline: Don Bradman Cricket Jr Announced for PC and Consoles
summary: "Don Bradman Cricket Jr" has been officially announced. The new title will be available on PC and consoles. Cricket fans can anticipate a new entry in the popular series.

headline: Jesse Eisenberg: Razzie Impacted Studio Movie Roles
summary: Jesse Eisenberg claims his career was affected by a Razzie Award. He won Worst Supporting Actor for Lex Luthor in "Batman v. Superman." Eisenberg suggests the award limited his access to studio film parts.

headline: Taika Waititi's Star Wars Movie 'On Ice'
summary: Director Taika Waititi confirms his Star Wars film is currently "on ice." The long-in-development project faces an uncertain future. This indicates a significant delay or potential halt in production.

headline: Macron Calls for Calm After France Riots
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron addressed the nation. He appealed for "calm and order" following widespread unrest. Some looting continued in Paris amid the disorder.

headline: Anti-Putin Sabotage: Inside Russia's Shadowy Network
summary: Two individuals detailed their work supporting Ukrainian intelligence. They claim to conduct anti-Putin sabotage operations within Russia. The report offers a glimpse into clandestine activities during the war.

headline: Russian Saboteur Shares Reconnaissance Videos for Ukraine
summary: A man claiming to be a Russian saboteur shared reconnaissance videos. He states he's working for Ukrainian intelligence. The saboteur claims involvement in drone attacks on Russian soil.

headline: Burnham: Youth Employment Crisis a 'Moral Failure'
summary: Andy Burnham warns of a potential "economic catastrophe" in the UK. One million young people are currently not in work or training. He described the youth employment and training crisis as a "moral failure."
